title: Cosmic Binary Vortex
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring two intertwined black hole-like vortices with glowing colorful accretion disks in teal, purple, orange and gold. A large ornate golden ribbon with geometric patterns flows around the left side of the composition against a starry space background.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene of two merging black holes with vibrant swirling accretion disks in teal, purple, orange, and gold. A large ornate golden metallic ribbon with geometric patterns flows dramatically around the left vortex. Bright light emission at the center where the two disks meet, set against deep space with distant stars, highly detailed digital painting with fluid colorful motion.
